name: Stone Steps
desc: A broad stone staircase climbing away to the horizon — lit tread tops and shadowed risers banding the plane, the nosings worn round and polished down the middle where a thousand feet have gone, and a raking light pool travelling up the flight so the bright step keeps moving as the whole run streams past; warm limestone, rain-wet, moss-grown, deep chiaroscuro, or a cyan setting-out plan.

energy.doc: how hard the light pool rakes the treads and how fast the flight streams past

scale.doc: tread depth in world units — min a fine flight of shallow steps, max monumental temple steps

density.doc: dust drifting low over the stone

speed.doc: how fast the camera climbs — the rate the steps stream down past you

wear.doc: a thousand feet — how round and polished the nosings are down the middle, moss in the risers

x.doc: vanishing point x as a canvas fraction

y.doc: horizon y as a canvas fraction — everything above stays fully transparent so the bg shows through

style.doc: aesthetic: warm weathered limestone under a raking light / rain-wet with sheen standing on the treads / long abandoned, moss risen in every riser / deep chiaroscuro, the steps pulled out of black by light alone / a cyan setting-out plan

seed.doc: stone lottery — per-step tone, grain and pitting
